messages:
kevin: Quick postmortem follow-up from the partial-response spike this morning. Root cause looks like an edge-case proxy half-close + client reconnect ordering. Need owners and timelines for the three remediation items I listed in the doc.
anya: I skimmed the trace dump — proxy sent FIN before server flush completed for ~2% of long streams. looks like keepalive/tcp timeouts plus aggressive NAT timeouts.
sam: Yep. Also saw clients re-opening before the server finished streaming which caused duplicates + partial chunks.
miguel: Suggested fixes: 1) server-side flush at end-of-stream, 2) explicit application-level end token, 3) client-side backoff jitter + validation for partial chunk reassembly.
kevin: Agree. Let's assign owners: re: server flush + app-level end token -> @linda; client jitter + reassembly -> @sam; infra (proxy config / tcp keepalive) -> @miguel. Can each of you confirm ETA?
linda: I can take server changes. I'll prep a small patch to call stream.flush() and append explicit <EOSTREAM> sentinel when stream finished. Will do a PR by EOD tomorrow (RINF-4321).
sam: Client SDK change + tests — I'll do a compatibility bump (semver minor). Plan: implement exponential jittered reconnect with max 5s and message checksum to detect partials. PR by Wednesday, tests by Thursday. Ticket RINF-4325.
miguel: I'll own proxy/tcp settings. Running an experiment to increase keepalive to 60s and NAT refresh pings. Will coordinate with infra to deploy to canary cluster tonight. ETA for cluster rollout: 48h. Ticket RINF-4327.
kevin: Great. Two more items: observability alerts (create metric for "stream-finalization" failures) and a retro-checklist to avoid recurrence. Who wants alerts?
anya: I'll add the metric and an alert (pager at P1 if >0.5% of streams fail finalization over 5m). Will put dashboards in the Console. ETA today.
sre-oncall: tagging in follow-up doc. Will add to oncall runbook: if alert fires, trigger rollback to previous proxy image and escalate to infra oncall.
ops-bot: Created task RINF-4321, RINF-4325, RINF-4327 and linked to incident-177993.kanban.
linda: Quick note: adding <EOSTREAM> sentinel might break very old clients. I'll add feature-flag guarded rollout and a canary with 10% traffic.
sam: Good call. My SDK will tolerate sentinel-less streams for 2 releases then default to strict validation.
miguel: For proxy changes: will run canary for 6 hours, gather long-tail metrics (90/95/99 latency for streaming endpoints) and patch if regressions.
kevin: Excellent. Owning timeline summary for incident doc (I'll update): server patch PR by EOD tomorrow, client PR Wed, proxy canary tonight -> full rollout in 48h, metrics/alert done today. Weekly follow-ups on Mon standup until stable.
linda: +1 to weekly checkins. Also will add a small integration test that simulates FIN mid-stream to catch regressions.
anya: Putting a short test harness in repo/replay-tests and adding to CI nightly for now.
sre-oncall: Noted, will link the CI job to incident and watch for alerts.
kevin: Thanks everyone. If any blocker appears, ping #eng-oncall and mark the ticket P0. Closing this thread once PRs are linked here. :thumbsup:
ops-bot: Deploy bot: canary deploy started for proxy config on cluster-canary at 1779930300.
kevin: copying final action list into the incident doc and adding owners/tickets. I'll post a short retro in general when we validate fixes.
anya: FYI — found two customer sessions that got partials, emailing CSMs with explanation + mitigation steps.
kevin: Great, please cc me. We'll include an SLA note if this repeats.
